cards.mood: The piece opens with a solitary, introspective mood that gradually accumulates tension through the verses.
cards.vocal: A single female lead vocalist delivers the performance with a rich, soulful timbre that ranges from a warm, breathy lower register to a powerful, ringing belt in the upper register.
cards.palette: A grand piano serves as the harmonic backbone, playing arpeggiated chords in the intro and verses, transitioning to fuller, block chord voicings in the choruses to drive the emotional weight.
